build_extract_flattened_patches: build flattened patches from batched image tensors with configurable patch size and max patch count
create_render_text: create a PIL image with rendered text using configurable font, size, color, and padding
run_normalize_images: run per-image mean and standard deviation normalization on batched image tensors
test_render_header: test rendering header text onto image tensors in channel-first format for VQA tasks
summarize_preprocess_images: summarize preprocessing pipeline that converts images to flattened patches with attention masks
